SV_OVERBURDEN_BAR.equation: Sv(z) = P_water + P_shallow + integral(rhob * g * dz)
SV_OVERBURDEN_BAR.inputs: Trajectory 1 TVD MSL, seawater depth 91.0 m (1.025 g/cm3), shallow density 1.90 g/cm3, bulk density log (RHOB)
SV_OVERBURDEN_BAR.assumptions: Vertical principle stress alignment; reference shallow density 1.90 g/cm3 for 91-262 m TVD MSL
SV_OVERBURDEN_BAR.uncertainty: +/- 1.26 bar (+/- 0.21%) across shallow density range 1.80 to 1.95 g/cm3

PH_HYDROSTATIC_BAR.inputs: Trajectory 1 TVD MSL, seabed 91.0 m, seawater 1.025 g/cm3, brine 1.030 g/cm3
PH_HYDROSTATIC_BAR.assumptions: Continuous normally pressured formation water column; uniform salinity
PH_HYDROSTATIC_BAR.uncertainty: +/- 0.5 bar across formation brine density range 1.025 to 1.035 g/cm3

SIGMA_V_HYDRO_BAR.assumptions: Nominal vertical effective stress under hypothetical normal pore fluid pressure
SIGMA_V_HYDRO_BAR.uncertainty: +/- 1.4 bar composite uncertainty from Sv and Ph
